registered.role: reviewer-capacity control: the cap's 1 reviewer per 3 builders

conditions.role: reviewer-capacity control: the cap's 1 reviewer per 3 builders

generalization_limits: one synthetic, six-task, stdlib-only Python package; larger tasks, other languages and real repositories may bend the curve differently
one host, the posix provider, one harness and one model; Orca and other providers schedule and isolate differently
agent reviewers only; human review capacity, the real serial bottleneck the attention budget names, is not measured
three runs per condition: enough to see a large effect, not to rule out a small one

recommendation.authority: the rule yields a recommendation only; changing a cap is its own human-reviewed policy change citing the report

rule.authority: the rule yields a recommendation only; changing a cap is its own human-reviewed policy change citing the report
rule.keep: otherwise, including every null or negative result
rule.lower: b1r1's 95% interval for throughput has a lower bound above b3r1's upper bound
rule.not_issued: fewer than three protocol-compliant runs, or compliant runs at fewer than three differing WIP settings
rule.raise: a condition above the current cap (b6r1 or b6r2) has a 95% interval for throughput whose lower bound exceeds b3r1's upper bound, with pooled rework no more than 0.10 above b3r1's and mean freshness violations per run no more than 1 above b3r1's

recommendation.why: no pre-registered criterion for a change is met (a null or negative result)
